summary: FortuneX Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the ordinary shares and warrants underlying the units, effective July 1, 2026. Units not separated continue trading as FXACU; separated shares and warrants trade as FXAC and FXACW. This is an administrative step following a SPAC IPO, not a special-situation event such as a merger or liquidation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic change are involved; it is a routine detachment of securities.
